description: A contemporary outdoor patio at dusk, photographed at a low seated angle in an off-center thirds composition. The ground plane is white and grey smooth river pebble gravel with large flat dark slate stepping stones laid at intervals. Both emit warm amber horizontal glow that illuminates the pebble surface beneath them in pools of gold. A small agave-type succulent plant peeks through the gravel in the lower frame. The middle ground contains a low white rectangular coffee table on angled white metal legs, holding a stack of books and a small glass vessel with dried botanicals. A compact grey upholstered outdoor sofa with a black accent pillow sits behind the coffee table. To the left background, a large spherical rattan hanging egg chair with grey cushions and a black-and-white graphic print pillow hangs from a wooden beam or tree. Dense tropical leafy plants in deep green fill the upper background. The overall palette is grey gravel, warm concrete, grey fabric, matte black accents, with amber light as the dominant atmospheric element.
